promptTemplate: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the ACTUAL original Plants vs Zombies 2009 helmet bitmaps in the top row, with an existing fan-variant identity reference repeated below. Make a usable transparent 3 columns by 2 rows skeletal sprite sheet. Redraw the TOP THREE parts in exactly the original native orientations and footprint: top left intact helmet, top center lightly damaged, top right heavily damaged. Keep bottom row unchanged as reference-only. Use original low-resolution soft cartoon paint and thin uneven brown outlines, muted colors, no photoreal texture, no shiny vector finish, no thick 3D strokes. Each helmet is a separate isolated part with a transparent background, no head or assembled zombie, no text. Preserve the original bottom brim / skull attachment, damage tears should remove chunks from upper edges without moving the base. All three top parts clearly belong to the SAME helmet design, with progressive cracks and missing sections, NOT three unrelated hats. Variant:

specs.identity: A folded brown cardboard-box helmet with a broad cream packing-tape strip and two simple dark square punched holes as in the lower reference. Intact, partially torn/crushed, heavily torn/crushed. Paper-like flat color only, no photographic cardboard texture.

An old muted gray metal bucket with a thin pale icy-blue frozen rim and two short blunt ice drips. Intact, dented with cracked frozen rim, badly dented with broken frozen rim. Preserve the original bucket shape and broad shading, no crystalline sparkle or realistic metal reflection.

Original orange traffic cone with two broad dull-gray reinforcing metal bands. Intact, slightly crumpled with one bent band, severely bent with one snapped band. Keep native orange and broad simple shading, no tiny screws or realistic metal.

Original gray bucket helmet with a modest dull steel wrench tucked along the side of the lower brim. Intact, partially dented, badly dented. Wrench shifts slightly with dents but remains the same simple identifiable prop. Keep original rusty broad soft shading, no polished metal or new extra tools.
